content.title: Speaking Test 12 — Technology
content.description: The full three-part interview: mobile phones in Part 1, a long turn on “Describe an app or a website that you find useful”, then a discussion of technology in daily life and technology at work.

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's talk about mobile phones.

What do you mainly use your phone for? [Why?]
How often do you change your phone? [Why/Why not?]
Are there times when you turn your phone off? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think you spend too much time on your phone? [Why/Why not?]
Describe an app or a website that you find useful.
bulletsHtml: how you found out about it
and explain why you find it useful

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's consider technology in daily life.

How has technology changed the way people keep in touch with friends?
Do you think older people find new technology difficult to learn?
What are the disadvantages of relying on technology for everything?

Let's consider technology at work.

Which jobs do you think machines will do in the future?
Is it a good thing that many people can now work from home?
Do you agree that technology has made people work longer hours?
